newsitem.title: USA: Leasing Edge to acquire Superior Computer.
newsitem.headline: Leasing Edge to acquire Superior Computer.

text.p: Leasing Edge Corp said Thursday it has entered into a letter of intent to acquire Superior Computer Systems.
Leasing Edge said in a statement it expects the acquisition will be accretive to earnings adding that it will boost market share by about 20 percent. Financial details were not disclosed.
Superior is a Minneapolis-based firm specializing in the distribution of IBM manufactured peripheral equipment as well as certain products manufactured by Hewlett-Packard Co and Sun Microsystems Inc.
Leasing Edge said in a statement Superior Computer's product line revenues, excluding direct vendor sales, total some $90 million annually. The deal is expected to close on November 1.
Leasing Edge leases a wide variety of computer and telecommunications equipment. Shares of the company closed 1/16 lower Thursday at 1-11/16 on Nasdaq.
